steps.text: Chicken (130/175 g) in 3 cm cubes. Rubbed with the oil (3 g flat, rapeseed — it's going under the grill), then 2 tsp suya (4/5 g) worked in with your hands.
Leave it 10 minutes while everything else happens — longer if you have it.
Plantain (85/130 g) sliced thick, dry-griddled 3 minutes a side.
Salad: pepper (100/120 g), tomato (100/120 g), cucumber (60/70 g) and red onion (40/50 g) diced small and rough, lettuce (60/70 g) torn in. Lime, salt, the rest of the oil (3/5 g, olive — finishing).
Dip: peanut butter (12/15 g) loosened with warm water, lemon, 1 tsp suya (2/2 g), salt.
Onto skewers, packed loosely, not crammed.
Grill, griddle or a very hot dry pan: 3–4 minutes a side, about 12 minutes total, until charred at the corners and just firm.
More suya (1/2 g) dusted over the skewers OFF the heat.

why: Suya twice — on before, dusted on after. It is a spice blend with ground peanut in it, and peanut burns. What goes on before the grill gives you the char; what goes on after gives you the flavour.
notes: D0-003: oil is used twice for genuinely different purposes — a flat 3 g rub (rapeseed, going under a hot grill) applied before the chicken is split by cover, and a per-cover remainder (3/5 g) dressing the raw salad at the end (olive, finishing). Split into two covers rows: rapeseed_oil 3/3, olive_oil 3/5 — sums to the original table (6/8).
'Lettuce ... torn in' is explicit whole-leaf preparation in the original step text, not shredded — D0-003's substitution does not apply here; stays lettuce (little gem/romaine), unchanged.

Seasoning addition (rule 5): suya appears three times in this card (2 tsp rub, 1 tsp dip, an unquantified 'more' dust) with no tracked gram row anywhere in meals.json. Total suya taken as 4 tsp (~16 g, new suya_spice id, see _ingredients.B.json), split proportionally to the chicken weight ratio (130:175) to get 7/9 g total, then apportioned across the three uses by their stated tsp ratio (2:1:1 -> rub 4/5 g, dip 2/2 g, dust 1/2 g); all three portions sum to the covers total (4+2+1=7 her, 5+2+2=9 him).

Macro drift from the suya addition is real: +36/+47 kcal roughly and +1.5/+2 g protein per cover (her/him) — above the 30 kcal note threshold. This is genuine, not an error: suya is a peanut-forward spice blend and was previously entirely unweighed in this dish despite being used three separate times.

Two tracks: chicken (rub -> marinate -> skewer -> grill -> finish) and sides (plantain, salad, dip) prepared during the 10-minute marinade wait. The 10-minute marinade is passive, not active — critical-path wall-clock total (~25 min) exceeds the card's activeMin (18) because of that wait, consistent with how activeMin is computed elsewhere in this dataset.

Step 7's 'Grill, griddle or a very hot dry pan' is left tempC:null — the original offers three hob-equivalent methods, not a committed oven/grill-appliance instruction, matching the same treatment given to every dry-griddle step elsewhere in this dataset (e.g. b-d3b's plantain, a-d3d's and a-d5b's plantain). No numeric grill temperature is stated anywhere in the source for this dish.
